answer: At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a willow tag. The vertex cap is policed at intake and canyon shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a swarm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
